newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain slams Israel over Jerusalem tunnel.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain slams Israel over Jerusalem tunnel.

text.p: Bahrain on Sunday condemned Israel's "repressive measures" against Palestinians, and urged other countries to press the Jewish state to honour agreements reached in the Middle East peace process.

The official Gulf News Agency said Bahrain's cabinet voiced its "condemnation of repressive measures Israel used against the Palestinian people and its expansionist policies...for opening a tunnel under the al-Aqsa mosque".
At least 55 Palestinians and 14 Israelis have been killed in clashes since the tunnel was opened in Jerusalem's Old City near al-Aqsa mosque, Islam's third holiest shrine.

The cabinet urged "the world community, especially the sponsors of the Middle East peace process, to work to pressure the Jewish state to change its policies and respect agreements and commitments reached as part of the Middle East peace process."
